title: 生物风险管理：绩效评估

points.K4: 评估、缓解、绩效：一个循环
points.K6: 绩效，就是计划与实际之差
points.K7: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
points.K8: 绩效是大家共同的结果
points.K15: 绩效测量是体系的一部分
points.K32: 评价体系本身也要改进

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室走廊，手里举着一块空白记分板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory corridor holding a blank scoreboard and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全工作做得好不好，怎么评？
overlay: 生物风险管理：绩效评估

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一把直尺和一个对勾图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a ruler and a check mark icon.
shots.narration: 今天讲绩效评估。

shots.scene: 年终总结会上，老周站在空白屏幕前
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in front of a blank projection screen at a year-end meeting.
shots.narration: 年底了，老周要总结实验室安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手，一脸轻松
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand looking relaxed.
shots.narration: 阿杰：没出大事，就是安全好呗。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，指着一叠空白记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points at a stack of blank records.
shots.narration: 小研：那小毛病、差点出事的呢？

shots.scene: 王老师推门进来，手里拿着空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks in holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 王老师：好不好，要量一量。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板上画出记录、尺子、天平三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws three icons on a whiteboard: a notebook, a ruler and a balance scale.
shots.narration: 记录、测量、评价我们做的事。

shots.scene: 风险箭头往下走
shots.prompt_en: A downward arrow over a risk gauge moving from red to green. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是把生物风险降下来。

shots.scene: 一面空白政策旗帜，箭头指向几个靶子
shots.prompt_en: A blank policy banner with arrows pointing to several targets. No people.
shots.narration: 单位的安全政策，要落成具体目标。

shots.scene: 王老师在靶子旁打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks a target with a check mark.
shots.narration: 再按标准，检查有没有做到。

shots.scene: 三个图标：靶心、天平、上升箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bullseye, a balance scale and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 学会定目标、比结果、做改进。

shots.section_title: 评估、缓解、绩效：一个循环
shots.scene: 三色循环图：放大镜、盾牌、尺子
shots.prompt_en: A three-part cycle diagram with a magnifier, a shield and a ruler icon in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估风险，再采取措施。
overlay: 评估、缓解、绩效：一个循环

shots.section_title: 评估、缓解、绩效：一个循环
shots.scene: 盾牌后留下一个小风险点，旁边有问号
shots.prompt_en: A shield with a small remaining risk dot behind it and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 剩下的风险，能不能接受？

shots.section_title: 评估、缓解、绩效：一个循环
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白审核表走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks into a laboratory holding a blank audit form.
shots.narration: 再通过审核，看措施管不管用。

shots.section_title: 评估、缓解、绩效：一个循环
shots.scene: 循环图转起来，向上螺旋
shots.prompt_en: The cycle diagram turns and spirals upward. No people.
shots.narration: 一圈圈循环，持续改进。

shots.scene: 一个大圆里有微生物、人、货车、楼房四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A large circle containing a microbe icon, a person icon, a delivery truck icon and a building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不只看病原，还要看人、物和设施。

shots.section_title: 绩效，就是计划与实际之差
shots.scene: 欣欣站在跑道起点，手里拿着秒表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the start line of a running track holding a stopwatch.
shots.narration: 打个比方：计划十五分钟跑完一公里。
overlay: 绩效，就是计划与实际之差

shots.section_title: 绩效，就是计划与实际之差
shots.scene: 欣欣气喘吁吁冲过终点，秒表显示多出一截
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot crosses the finish line out of breath while the stopwatch dial shows extra time.
shots.narration: 实际跑了二十分钟。

shots.section_title: 绩效，就是计划与实际之差
shots.scene: 天气、体能、跑鞋三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a rain cloud, a tired heart and a worn running shoe. No people.
shots.narration: 天气、体能、装备，找出拖后腿的。

shots.section_title: 绩效，就是计划与实际之差
shots.scene: 两个图标：对勾和眼睛，中间一个差值箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a check mark and an eye, with a gap arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 计划和实际的差距，就是绩效。

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 王老师展示一张三行空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator presents a blank table with three rows and three columns.
shots.narration: 年初定目标：事件少于5，事故少于3，
overlay: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 表格第二列填入实际数字图标
shots.prompt_en: The second column of the table fills with number icons. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒零起；实际是6、0、1。

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 事件一栏的数字超出目标，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: One row of the table turns red with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 事件超了，可能规程有漏洞。

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 规程修订和培训两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a document being revised with a pencil and a training classroom. No people.
shots.narration: 就修订规程，加强培训。

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 溢洒一栏也亮起红色
shots.prompt_en: Another row of the table turns red with a spill icon. No people.
shots.narration: 目标零溢洒，实际有一次，也要改。

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 事故一栏亮起绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: The accident row lights up with a green tick. No people.
shots.narration: 事故达标，不用另加措施。

shots.section_title: 年度对比表：差在哪，怎么改
shots.scene: 放大镜逐条查看每一起事件
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier examines a list of blank incident reports one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 每一起事件和事故，都要调查。

shots.section_title: 绩效是大家共同的结果
shots.scene: 全实验室的人围成一圈，中间一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: All lab members stand in a circle with a check mark in the middle: the older man, the female graduate student, the young male student and the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 绩效，是每个人努力的总和。
overlay: 绩效是大家共同的结果

shots.section_title: 绩效是大家共同的结果
shots.scene: 实际曲线在计划线下方波动
shots.prompt_en: An actual performance line fluctuating below a planned target line on a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 实际常常达不到计划。

shots.section_title: 绩效是大家共同的结果
shots.scene: 一条曲线要靠人不断往上推
shots.prompt_en: A person icon pushing a line upward on a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 绩效会变，要一直用力。

shots.scene: 齿轮、脚印、对勾三个图标连成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of three connected icons: a gear, footprints and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一个流程：输入、步骤、输出。

shots.scene: 样本管进入流程，每一步旁边一个空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube moves through a process with a blank logbook beside each step. No people.
shots.narration: 比如检测样本，每一步都记下来。

shots.scene: 王老师举起四个手指
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up four fingers.
shots.narration: 设计评估前，先问四个问题。

shots.scene: 奔跑的小人和指路手势两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a running figure and a pointing hand. No people.
shots.narration: 步骤做得到吗？步骤对不对？

shots.scene: 对勾和量尺两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a check mark and a measuring tape. No people.
shots.narration: 结果达标吗？量的东西对吗？

shots.scene: 检测实验室门口，五个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Five person icons standing at the door of a testing laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 某结核检测室，要降低人员暴露。

shots.scene: 体检、防护规程、复查三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a health check clipboard, a protective equipment procedure sheet and a follow-up check calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 上岗前体检、防护规程、结束后复查。

shots.scene: 五个人形中有一个变红
shots.prompt_en: Five person icons with one turned red. No people.
shots.narration: 结果，五人中有一人检测阳性。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周一起审视空白规程，眉头紧锁
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man examine a blank procedure document with serious expressions.
shots.narration: 规程合适吗？哪里出了漏洞？

shots.scene: 放大镜、修订规程、箭头循环
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifier, a revised document and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 做事故分析，采取纠正措施。

shots.scene: 一条基准线，几个柱子有的达标有的不达标
shots.prompt_en: A bar chart with a benchmark line; some bars reach it and some do not. No people.
shots.narration: 看体系哪里达标，哪里没有。

shots.scene: 没达标的柱子旁一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A large question mark next to a short bar. No people.
shots.narration: 没达标，就要问为什么。

shots.scene: 审核员翻看一叠空白记录
shots.prompt_en: An auditor in a suit reviews a stack of blank records.
shots.narration: 认证认可时，审核员要看记录。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标和一个向下的钱币箭头
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a downward arrow over coins. No people.
shots.narration: 还能预防事故，减少开支。

shots.scene: 四级台阶：尺子、灯泡、方向盘、上升箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four steps with icons: a ruler, a lightbulb, a steering wheel and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 量出来，才看得懂。

shots.scene: 欣欣沿台阶往上走
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot climbs up the four steps.
shots.narration: 看得懂才控制得住，才谈得上改进。

shots.scene: 空白问卷和尺子
shots.prompt_en: A blank questionnaire next to a ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 测量要用合适的工具。

shots.scene: 事故后一群人围着放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A group of icons gathered around a magnifier after an accident sign. No people.
shots.narration: 只在出事后分析，太晚了。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验室里观察大家操作
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator quietly observes researchers working in the lab.
shots.narration: 多观察日常行为，提前发现苗头。

shots.scene: 王老师和另一位安全管理员交流
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator chats with another safety officer from a different building.
shots.narration: 多听同行的经验和教训。

shots.section_title: 绩效测量是体系的一部分
shots.scene: 一台机器里嵌着一个尺子齿轮
shots.prompt_en: A machine with a ruler-shaped gear built into it. No people.
shots.narration: 绩效测量，不是另外一摊事。
overlay: 绩效测量是体系的一部分

shots.section_title: 绩效测量是体系的一部分
shots.scene: 规程文件和实际操作两个图标被同一把尺子量
shots.prompt_en: One ruler measuring both a procedure document icon and a hands-at-work icon. No people.
shots.narration: 规程写的，和实际做的，都要量。

shots.scene: 数据点汇入一个漏斗，下面出来图表
shots.prompt_en: Data points flowing into a funnel and coming out as a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 确定要什么数据，收集，再分析。

shots.scene: 图表上一个灯泡亮起
shots.prompt_en: A lightbulb lights up above a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 看体系是否合适、有效，哪里能改。

shots.scene: 走廊天花板上的监控摄像头和电脑图表
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling security camera in a corridor and a computer screen showing a blank chart. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以借助监控和智能分析。

shots.scene: 会议桌旁，老周和王老师翻阅空白报告，墙上挂日历
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator review blank reports at a meeting table with a calendar on the wall.
shots.narration: 管理层要定期评审，比如每年一次。

shots.scene: 三个图标：合适、充分、有效
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a puzzle piece fitting, a full container and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 体系是否合适、充分、有效。

shots.scene: 制度、程序、目标三份文件被标上修改笔
shots.prompt_en: Three blank documents marked with a revision pen. No people.
shots.narration: 该改的制度、程序和目标，就改。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白计划表上列问题
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator lists questions on a blank planning sheet.
shots.narration: 测量之前，先把问题想清楚。

shots.scene: 问卷图标和一个跟在研究生身后看操作的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a questionnaire and an observer standing behind a researcher at a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 可以发问卷，也可以现场跟看。

shots.scene: 一面空白旗帜和一颗心
shots.prompt_en: A blank flag with a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 政策，表明决心和方向。

shots.scene: 旗帜下面分出职责、目标、步骤三条路
shots.prompt_en: Three paths branching from the flag toward person, target and footprint icons. No people.
shots.narration: 要再分解成职责、目标和步骤。

shots.scene: 足球飞入球门
shots.prompt_en: A soccer ball flying into a goal net. No people.
shots.narration: 目标，是看得见、量得出的结果。

shots.scene: 空白记分板上一个大大的零
shots.prompt_en: A blank scoreboard showing a large zero. No people.
shots.narration: 比如：实验结束，零感染。

shots.scene: 人沿着楼梯一步步向上，楼梯旁有日历
shots.prompt_en: The young male student climbs a staircase step by step with a calendar beside it.
shots.narration: 具体目标，是限时完成的步骤。

shots.scene: 一份空白规程上有编号的步骤
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet with numbered step icons. No people.
shots.narration: 最典型的，就是标准操作规程。

shots.scene: 五支箭射向同一个靶心
shots.prompt_en: Five arrows converging on one bullseye. No people.
shots.narration: 具体、可测量、能实现、合理、有时限。

shots.scene: 一个够不着的高靶子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unreachable target high on a cliff, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别定做不到的目标，审核会指出来。

shots.scene: 仪表盘指针
shots.prompt_en: A dashboard gauge with a moving needle. No people.
shots.narration: 指标，要能问出多少次、多少量。

shots.scene: 日历上每月同一天打勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with the same day ticked every month. No people.
shots.narration: 定期用，一直用同一把尺子。

shots.scene: 曲线偏离，提前亮起黄灯
shots.prompt_en: A line on a chart drifting off course with an early yellow warning light. No people.
shots.narration: 能看出偏离，在出事前报警。

shots.scene: 流程、团队、手势、盾牌四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a flowchart, a team, a hand gesture and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 先行指标：过程、文化、行为、屏障。

shots.scene: 王老师在计划表上提前写下这些指标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes indicators on a blank plan in advance.
shots.narration: 事先定好，为安全工作指方向。

shots.scene: 事件、事故、险兆、整改四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: an exclamation mark, a bandage, a near-miss swerve arrow and a corrective order document. No people.
shots.narration: 滞后指标：事件、事故、险兆、整改。

shots.scene: 后视镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A rear-view mirror icon showing a past event. No people.
shots.narration: 都是事后才看到的。

shots.scene: 王老师和大家围坐讨论指标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits with the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discussing a blank list.
shots.narration: 好指标，大家一起商量出来。

shots.scene: 相关、客观、及时、省钱四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a puzzle piece, a balance scale, a clock and a coin. No people.
shots.narration: 相关、客观、及时，成本合理。

shots.scene: 指标指向纠正措施和灯泡
shots.prompt_en: An indicator arrow pointing to a wrench and a lightbulb. No people.
shots.narration: 能指导整改，带来改进机会。

shots.scene: 一把尺子和一个“容易”图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shortcut icon crossed out with a red X next to a ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 要量什么，就选什么，不图省事。

shots.scene: 金字塔三层各有一个尺子
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid with a ruler at each level. No people.
shots.narration: 能量化，覆盖各个层级。

shots.scene: 疏散演练：大家沿箭头走向集合点，王老师记录
shots.prompt_en: During an evacuation drill, researchers walk along arrows to an assembly point while the safety administrator writes on a blank record.
shots.narration: 演练有没有做？记录就是证据。

shots.scene: 培训日历、防护用品架、检查表三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a training calendar, a stocked protective equipment shelf and an audit checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 培训、防护用品、检查的频次和范围。

shots.scene: 规程和标准书并排，中间对勾
shots.prompt_en: A procedure document and a standards book side by side with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 做法是否符合现行标准规范。

shots.scene: 委员会会议，桌上一份空白指标清单盖章
shots.prompt_en: A committee meeting where a blank indicator list is stamped.
shots.narration: 度量标准，委员会事先定好。

shots.scene: 简单的柱状图，大家都看得懂
shots.prompt_en: A simple bar chart shown to the older man and the young male student, who both nod.
shots.narration: 数据要呈现得让人看得懂。

shots.scene: 日历、尺子、钱币三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a calendar, a ruler and a coin. No people.
shots.narration: 定好时间段、方法和成本。

shots.scene: 检查人员紧贴在研究生身后，研究生紧张冒汗
shots.prompt_en: An inspector stands too close behind the female graduate student, who looks nervous and sweaty.
shots.narration: 盯得太紧，人一紧张反而出错。

shots.scene: 检查人员站在适当距离，研究生从容操作
shots.prompt_en: The inspector stands at a respectful distance while the female graduate student works calmly.
shots.narration: 收集数据，尽量不打扰正常工作。

shots.scene: 王老师一个人坐在桌前专心分析图表，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits alone focusing on charts with an hourglass beside him.
shots.narration: 分析要花时间和资源。

shots.scene: 老周把任务卡和日历交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a task card and a calendar to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 指定专人，给定期限，专心做完。

shots.section_title: 评价体系本身也要改进
shots.scene: 灯泡亮起，旁边一把旧尺子
shots.prompt_en: A lightbulb lights up next to an old ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 评价体系本身，也要定期检查。
overlay: 评价体系本身也要改进

shots.section_title: 评价体系本身也要改进
shots.scene: 四个问号图标
shots.prompt_en: Four question mark icons. No people.
shots.narration: 指标还相关吗？要不要换新的？

shots.section_title: 评价体系本身也要改进
shots.scene: 从别处搬来的尺子量不准本实验室的形状，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A borrowed ruler that does not fit the shape of the lab icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 照搬别处的指标，未必合用。

shots.scene: 三色循环图，绩效那一块亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three-part cycle diagram with the performance part glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 绩效评估，是循环的第三步。

shots.scene: 旗帜、靶子、尺子、放大镜、扳手连成一条链
shots.prompt_en: A chain of icons: a flag, a target, a ruler, a magnifier and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 政策变目标，定指标，查原因，再整改。

shots.scene: 整改后曲线回升
shots.prompt_en: A line on a chart rising back up after a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 整改之后，还要看效果。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着图表向老周汇报，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows a chart to the older man, who nods in agreement.
shots.narration: 数据，也是说服领导投入的依据。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三色循环图旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the three-part cycle diagram.
shots.narration: 计划与实际比一比，差距就是改进点。

shots.scene: 目标、指标、评审三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bullseye, a gauge and a meeting table. No people.
shots.narration: 目标可测，指标先行，定期评审。

shots.scene: 一个向前的箭头和一个向后的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A forward arrow and a backward arrow side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 先行指标定方向，滞后指标看结果。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白表格上认真填写指标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carefully fills in a blank indicator table.
shots.narration: 阿杰：原来安全也能量出来。

shots.scene: 欣欣、王老师、老周、小研和阿杰站在记分板前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the safety administrator, the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand in front of a blank scoreboard and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 量一量，改一改，安全天天好，再见！
